scope: Measured automatic GNU/fd routing and explicitly experimental finite broader fd semantics, independently compared against GNU.

requirements.contract: Public/private calls automatically use the measured sparse large-layered name/type fd family. Small/dense/shallow/rich/action/unsupported classes use original GNU before Node. Explicit off/0 or set nonexact experimental flag uses GNU. Pi allowed-provider model Bash calls get the same private policy; user commands, native bypasses and child scripts remain GNU. Routing predicts measured class speed, not every future call.

Under exact FIND2FD_EXPERIMENTAL_FD=1: fd supplies actual candidates for supported pure and GNU metadata/format expressions. Physical preorder controls evaluate each node under GNU before immediate fd descent. Unsupported actions/diagnostics and buffered compatibility/resource failures retain original GNU before publication; incremental listing faults continue locally without replay.

Under exact FIND2FD_EXPERIMENTAL_FD=1: GNU precedence, short circuiting, negation, comma, implicit printing and repeated/mixed print actions remain exact through fd; unsupported actions retain native GNU execution.
Exact starting-point spelling, root inclusion, hidden/ignored entries, traversal order and repeated/overlapping root multiplicity match GNU.
Newlines, Unicode and invalid UTF-8 names/argv preserve exact raw output and native argv bytes.

Buffered traversal failures retain original GNU before output. Once the incremental evaluator starts, fd failures use local depth-one GNU discovery and never replay original argv or prior output; diagnostics/status remain GNU-owned.

Exec, file-output and deletion actions execute exactly once under original GNU, and stdin-root lists are not consumed by fd preflight. Arbitrary root actions creating/deleting/modifying later entries retain native behavior without fd credit.
The private non-exported Bash function preserves native bypasses, children and outside shells; optional Pi native bash adaptation is gated dynamically by exact provider.
An actual npm tarball extracts and installs offline; its public entry and helper retain byte/status/scope behavior.
A finite seeded campaign compares actual CLI bytes/status with GNU and records distinct fd/native routes and actual fd executions separately.
Test-only root-output/order/fallback and ignored-prune mutations are rejected by semantic GNU output and directory-access-time oracles; syntax and infrastructure failures receive no mutation credit.
Cancellation and deadlines terminate owned descendants; inherited raw or removed working directories retain GNU behavior.

The pure byte evaluator is gated by syntax and locale; arbitrary GNU globs, regex dialects and metadata use fd traversal plus GNU candidate evaluation. Directory access-time effects, split diagnostic duplication and bounded expression/capture limits remain explicit native boundaries.

Finite seeded complete expression comparisons against actual GNU verify nested operators, print side effects and candidate pushdown using observed fd/native executions; unsupported syntax/actions preserve native execution.

Under exact FIND2FD_EXPERIMENTAL_FD=1: Independent complete GNU CLI comparisons require real fd traversal; all GNU evaluator calls use depth zero on ordered candidates, and compile-only validations, candidate evaluations and original recursive fallback are recorded separately. Numeric size rounding, permissions, owners, inode/links, emptiness, times/references, regex/globs and symlink predicates retain GNU semantics.

GNU printf and ls preserve exact bytes, widths, precision, escapes and Boolean repeated effects, including original root label, relative path and depth across overlapping/repeated/aliased roots and invalid UTF-8 descendant names.

Actual fd execution preserves depth order and H/L root/descendant dereference policy. An owned cross-filesystem symlink regression preserves both GNU expression-dependent results through observed native fallback, which receives no completed acceleration credit.

Buffered traversal routes directory/symlink access-time observations to original GNU before fd can change them; regular-file-only output proofs permit acceleration. Incremental physical preorder evaluates the current node before opening its directory and prune/quit leave its access time unchanged.

requirements.owner: GNU root and global option parsing
requirements.contract: Leading --, numeric optimization spellings including zero padding, and noignore_readdir_race use actual fd with exact independent GNU outputs. Invalid optimization, late flags, delimiter misuse and action mixtures retain exact original GNU diagnostics before fd.

Public/private calls preserve auxiliary FD3/FD63/FD4097 for exec and samefile references plus process substitution, reserving an unused evaluator input descriptor. Closed caller descriptors remain errors instead of exposing Node internals. Closed standard0/1/2 retain GNU output/status/errors. Direct runFind supports explicit callerDescriptors for low FD3.

Under exact FIND2FD_EXPERIMENTAL_FD=1: Finite-depth physical preorder GNU prune/quit preserve Boolean truth, short circuiting, comma, implicit printing, raw filename bytes, original roots/order and no-descent access times. GNU owns public streams via a private FIFO and control PTY; immediate fd listings occur only after current-node evaluation. Unsafe action/traversal mixtures remain native with no fd credit. Unbounded controls and unsafe root/depth pathname budgets use original GNU before helper startup; a controlled beyond-PATH_MAX tree confirms native full output without false fd credit.

Malformed/error fd listings continue through local GNU depth-one discovery without replay; paused sinks retain exact complete bytes, handled signals exit within a bounded deadline and remove owned FIFO/PTY state. Failed engine peers receive zero real-fd credit.

Audit all inventory spellings and structural families; measured sparse large trees execute actual fd with full byte order/status/diagnostic equality. Dispatch, density sampling and ordering cost belongs in end-to-end randomized paired speed captures. Slower/incompatible classes route GNU without Node; no universal-speed assertion.
